initialDiscovery: One authorized Moto g56 5G; portrait 1080x2400; foreground org.fossify.home, observed through the Studio MCP before mutations.

questions.question: Can the agent discover and enter the installed emulator from the launcher without assuming an already loaded game?
questions.pass: Installed launcher activity resolved, foreground observed after launch, Pokemon content visually identified.
questions.limit: Launching the emulator is not proof of loading Pokemon; ROM selection remains a separate observation.

questions.question: Does the existing FNaF Companion SNAP capture this non-FNaF app and its current geometry?
questions.pass: A valid native frame identifies the emulator content and retains native timestamps; compare its geometry with an independent ADB witness.
questions.limit: No cross-clock latency claim; initial failure is retained; capture consent may require setup.

questions.question: Do Studio preconditions distinguish launcher, emulator and absent game facts?
questions.pass: Wrong foreground gives FAIL, unavailable semantic game fact gives UNKNOWN, Android contact plan is refused before dispatch.
questions.limit: A package match does not prove game state or visual input acceptance.

questions.question: Do nominally short and held Start contacts open the game menu under a retained geometry?
questions.pass: Each attempt has fresh pre/post images, explicit nominal duration and a visual verdict; restore the observed overworld between trials.
questions.limit: Exploratory observations only; not a success-rate estimate or Android touch landing measurement. No player movement, saving, battle or settings change.

questions.question: Can a Home interruption be detected and the emulator resumed with the same game state?
questions.pass: Observe foreground before, during and after interruption; compare game content and the outcome of Studio guards.
questions.limit: Home/resume only; no force-stop, save edit or claim of process-death recovery.

evidence: Retain local PNG/XML and original operation records; commit derived JSON, source hashes and media hashes only.
execution: Studio MCP/runtime for observations and guards; original FNaF lease/SNAP for device ownership and native capture; bounded diagnostic ADB actions outside the production runtime, explicitly labelled.
stop: Stop game inputs if foreground, geometry or overworld/menu precondition is not observed. Stop on disconnection, unexpected dialog, contradictory capture or repeated failure.
